subject: Trading
title: Analysis Paralysis
description: A micro-lesson that makes Analysis Paralysis usable.

hook.text: You see the setup. It's clean. But you check one more indicator, one more timeframe, one more opinion. It's gone.

buildup.text: Analysis paralysis strikes when fear of being wrong prevents action. More data becomes a hiding place.

discovery.text: After a certain point, additional information doesn't improve decision quality—it just delays execution.

twist.text: The opposite extreme—impulsive action—is equally harmful. The goal is confident, timely decisions.

climax.text: Having a checklist—three to five criteria—forces a decision. If it meets the criteria, you act. Period.

punchline.text: A good plan executed now beats a perfect plan never.

quiz.question: What causes analysis paralysis?
options: Fear of being wrong leading to endless analysis and delayed action
